- Primary success metric (we suggested 30-day active user validation)
- Data scope / sample size for acceptance tests
- Any procurement-specific milestones (PO, legal redlines)

Attachments: redwood_map_template_bank_v2.pdf (templates), cost-latency-estimates.xlsx (straw numbers).

I'll loop in Connor from infra if you want deeper network/VPC details. Happy to schedule a 30-minute kickoff once you've had a chance to look — is next Wednesday 11/17 10am PT ok?

Thanks,
